.github/workflows/default-poster-validat.predecessor_lf:
name: Default Poster Candidate Validation
'on':
  pull_request:
    branches:
    - main
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: default-poster-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  collection:
    name: Collect original (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
        - ubuntu-latest
        - windows-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
      with:
        python-version: '3.13'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: |
          create_defaults/requirements.txt
          create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: python -m pip install -r create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - name: Collect original pytest and unittest IDs
      run: python ci/validation.py collect
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      if: ${{ always() }}
      with:
        name: collection-${{ matrix.os }}
        path: config/ci-validation/**
        retention-days: 14
        if-no-files-found: error
  validation:
    name: Validate (${{ matrix.os }}, ${{ matrix.group }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && (matrix.group == 'contracts' || matrix.group == 'people') && 60 || 15 }}
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
        - ubuntu-latest
        - windows-latest
        group:
        - core
        - historical
        - contracts
        - categories
        - generation
        - review
        - people
        - smoke
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
      with:
        python-version: '3.13'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: |
          create_defaults/requirements.txt
          create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: python -m pip install -r create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - name: Run bounded required validation
      env:
        BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      run: python ci/validation.py run --group "${{ matrix.group }}" --base "$BASE_SHA"
    - name: Retain local-only review evidence for the team
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: package-d-focused-review-${{ matrix.os }}
        retention-days: 14
        if-no-files-found: error
        path: |
          config/package-d-smoke/smoke-evidence.json
          config/package-d-smoke/layout-proposal.json
          config/package-d-smoke/cache/preview-reports/**
          config/package-d-smoke/cache/preflight/**
          config/package-d-smoke/output/**
      if: ${{ matrix.group == 'smoke' }}
    - name: Retain focused Package E acceptance evidence
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: package-e-focused-acceptance-${{ matrix.os }}
        retention-days: 14
        if-no-files-found: error
        path: |
          config/package-e-ci/ci-evidence.json
          config/package-e-ci/posters/*summary.json
          config/package-e-ci/posters/output-verification.json
          config/package-e-ci/posters/verified-output-ledger.json
          config/package-e-ci/posters/output/defaults-en/based/**
          config/package-e-ci/posters/output/defaults-en/decade/2020.jpg
          config/package-e-ci/posters/output/defaults-en/decade/best/2020.jpg
          config/package-e-ci/overlays/overlay-summary.json
          config/package-e-ci/overlays/output-ledger.json
          config/package-e-ci/overlays/output/**
      if: ${{ matrix.group == 'smoke' }}
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      if: ${{ always() }}
      with:
        name: validation-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.group }}
        path: config/ci-validation/**
        retention-days: 14
        if-no-files-found: error
  acceptance:
    name: Validation acceptance
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs:
    - collection
    - validation
    - phase3
    - phase4
    - people_security
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      REQUIRED_JOB_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
      BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
      with:
        python-version: '3.13'
        cache: pip
        cache-dependency-path: |
          create_defaults/requirements.txt
          create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
      with:
        path: config/ci-downloaded
        pattern: validation-*
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
      with:
        path: config/ci-downloaded
        pattern: collection-*
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
      with:
        path: config/ci-downloaded
        pattern: phase3-foundations-*
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
      with:
        path: config/ci-downloaded
        pattern: phase4-*
    - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093
      with:
        path: config/ci-downloaded
        pattern: people-security-*
    - name: Require all groups and reconcile exact test IDs and non-pytest gates
      # Phase 4 artifacts have their own namespace and mandatory exact-ID proof.
      run: python ci/validation.py verify --directory config/ci-downloaded --base "$BASE_SHA"
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
      with:
        name: coverage-equivalence
        path: config/ci-validation/coverage-equivalence.json
        retention-days: 14
        if-no-files-found: error
  phase3:
    name: Phase 3 foundations (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.os == 'windows-latest' && 60 || 15 }}
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'

      run:
        shell: bash

    - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
      with:

          create_defaults/requirements.txt
          create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: python -m pip install -r create_defaults/requirements-bulk.txt
    - name: Focused schema, authority, isolation and full test-ID proof
      run: python ci/phase3.py run

      if: ${{ always() }}

  phase4:

      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
        - ubuntu-latest
        - windows-latest
        group:
        - foundations
        - add_update
        - atomic
        - recovery
        - concurrency
        - competing_updates
        - membership
        - shared_source

    steps:

  contents: read
jobs:

    name: People publication reliability (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Install pinned qualification dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --require-hashes -r create_people_posters/bulk/requirements.lock -r create_people_posters/bulk/test-requirements.lock
      - name: Verify protected publication registration
        run: python -m unittest discover -s ci/publication_tests -v
      - name: Qualify crash recovery and 5000-record offline publication
        run: python -m pytest create_people_posters/reliability_tests -q
  docker:
    name: People bulk Docker (Linux)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Verify exact Unicode successor, current provenance and tamper controls
        run: python -m unittest discover -s ci/unicode_tests -v

        run: |
          git worktree add --detach "$RUNNER_TEMP/people-pr63" 05ea93ba4b75a6c8fbd3755bdf817cb6c8485338
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/people-pr63"
          python -m unittest discover -s ci/bulk_tests -v
          docker build --target test -t people-bulk-jost-tests -f create_people_posters/bulk/Dockerfile .
          docker run --rm --network none --cpus 4 --memory 8g --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=4g,mode=1777 people-bulk-jost-tests
      - name: Build isolated test image
        run: docker build --target unicode-test -t people-bulk-tests -f create_people_posters/bulk/Dockerfile .
      - name: Run offline rendering, sync, validation and publication-safety fixtures
        run: docker run --rm --network none --cpus 4 --memory 8g --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=4g,mode=1777 people-bulk-tests
      - name: Build production image without publishing it
        run: docker build --target release -t people-bulk -f create_people_posters/bulk/Dockerfile .
